derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G1553 (ἐκδημέω);
def: a co-absentee from home, i.e. fellow-traveller

occurrences.text: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
